_readme: Copy this file to participants.json (git-ignored) and fill in real numbers in E.164 format (+91 then 10 digits, no spaces). consent.recording must be true before the kit will dial someone. consent.scope: 'public' = their voice/transcript may appear in the public demo, video and repo; 'metrics_only' = audio and transcript stay private, only aggregate numbers are published.

consent.how: WhatsApp reply to the consent message
